rows.label: Effects
cells: Unlocks the "Open Grimoire" menu in the pause menu.

c: Grim Grimoire is located to the far west of the starting area in Inlaid Library. Its location is tracked by a green arrow on the player's screen. It is protected by 2 patrolling
Undead Witches that slow the player down using a beam attack while firing bullets at them. Once Grim Grimoire has been collected, it will no longer appear on the map.
Alternatively, Grim Grimoire can be unlocked in the
by casting the spell "thisshouldhavebeenunlockedbydefault".
If the player has obtained this relic without having obtained the

beforehand, by default, Grim Grimoire will become immediately accessible upon pausing the game, with options becoming accessible in a different way, where the player would have to pause the game and then click the "Options" button, instead of only clicking the pause button.

If the player has both Grim Grimoire and the Milky Way Map, the player would have to access Grim Grimoire by pressing the pause button and then the "Open Grimoire" button, just to the left of the "RESUME" button.
Grim Grimoire in use.

Grim Grimoire shows evolutions that have been obtained before, and hides any evolutions that have yet to be encountered. However, it does show whether a set of weapons and passives result in an evolution, even if the weapons or passives have yet to be discovered. An exception is made for evolutions that require the
, which are hidden until said relic is obtained.
Once a player obtains a weapon and/or a passive item, its sprite in Grim Grimoire will be highlighted with a yellow-greenish square. If the player has evolved a weapon (for example, evolved the
and the
to get the
), the equation indicating the evolution in Grim Grimoire will be entirely highlighted. This is also the case where the player has selected a character that starts with an evolved weapon, such as
, who starts with the
, even if they have not obtained the
or the
beforehand.

If the player has obtained the maximum number of weapons and/or passives, the evolution equations that would remain completely visible in Grim Grimoire are the ones where an evolution has already occurred, the ones where all of the items needed for the evolution are equipped, or the ones where the player has at least one of the required items needed for the evolution while having the other required item(s) obtainable through leveling up and not through a weapon selector, such as the
or the
. The rest of the evolution equations, where an evolution is no longer possible by obtaining the remaining required item(s) by leveling up, will look more faded.
The list of evolutions is separated by pagination, depending on how many evolutions the player has discovered.
